== 00001.inc
#declare Photons=off;

#declare PlankNormal =
  normal
  { gradient x 2 slope_map { [0 <0,1>][.05 <1,0>][.95 <1,0>][1 <0,-1>] }
    scale 2
  };

#declare seee = seed(5);
#declare contrast = 1.0;
#declare Lightsys_Scene_Scale = 0.1;

#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

#include "bpp_lightsys.inc"
#include "bpp_CIE.inc"
#include "bpp_espd_cie_standard.inc"
#include "bpp_espd_lightsys.inc"
#include "bpp_lightsys_constants.inc"

#include "finish.inc"
#include "textures.inc"

#include "mesh_#.inc"

#include "mesh_#.inc"

#include "mesh_#.inc"

#include "mesh_#.inc"

#include "mesh_#.inc"

#macro Raster(RScale, HLine)
   pigment{ gradient x scale RScale
            color_map{[0.000   color rgbt<1,1,1,1>*0.6]
                      [0+HLine color rgbt<1,1,1,1>*0.6]
                      [0+HLine color rgbt<1,1,1,1>]
                      [1-HLine color rgbt<1,1,1,1>]
                      [1-HLine color rgbt<1,1,1,1>*0.6]
                      [1.000   color rgbt<1,1,1,1>*0.6]} }
   finish { ambient 0.15 diffuse 0.85}
#end

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

// ground
#declare RasterScale = 1.0 ;
#declare RasterHalfLine  = 0.045;
#declare RasterHalfLineZ = 0.045;

// lamp
object {
  Light(
    EmissiveSpectrum(ES_GTE_341_Cool),
    Lm_Incandescent_100w,
    x*2.45, z*2.45, 4, 4, on
  )
  translate <0, 55, 10>
}

camera {
  location < 250, 300, -1000 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <-233834, -271237, 932527>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(1.14592)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <-0.0660439, 0.962428, 0.263383>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 5
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 10, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

global_settings {
  max_trace_level 15
}

object { mesh_#
  pigment { color ReferenceRGB(<0.9,0.8,0.3>) }
  finish {
    diffuse .6
    phong .75
    phong_size 25
  }

  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          1,3.9,-5.55>
}

object { mesh_#

  }

          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          1,7,-6.5>
}

}

object {

    sphere {0,1}
    #for (i,1,70)
      sphere {0,1 scale (rand(seee)*0.04+0.01)
      translate y*(0.3+0.5*rand(seee))
      rotate <rand(seee)*360,0,rand(seee)*360>}
    #end
    union {
      blob { threshold  0.1
        #for (i,-0.9,0.9,0.01)
          sphere {0,1, 0.2 scale <sin(((i+1)*pi/2))*0.8,0.1,0.08>
          translate y*(i) rotate <0,i*150,0>}
        #end
        texture {
          pigment{ color rgb <0.058823529411765, 0.6156862745098, 0.34509803921569> }
          finish { diffuse 0.9 phong 0.8 ambient 1.2}
        }
      }
      blob {
        threshold  0.1
        #for (i,-0.9,0.9,0.01)
          sphere {0,1, 0.2 scale <sin(((i+1)*pi/2))*0.8,0.1,0.08>
          translate y*(i) rotate <0,90+i*150,0>}
        #end
        texture {
          pigment{ color rgb <1, 1, 1> }
          finish {diffuse 0.9 phong 0.8 ambient 1.2}
        }
      }
    }
    texture { Glass }
    interior {
      ior 1.5 caustics 0.25
    }
    photons {  // photon block for an object
      target 1.0
      refraction on
      reflection on
    }
